64-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2301-4279-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

333-997-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-997-8207.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1626-3249-3755--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1626-3249-3755--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Headless Rider triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that Zombie from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.
728-1626-3249-3755--206.notes: Some of the one-drop Zombie creatures in the template adds more powerful results, and Gravecrawler does not require Havengul Lich.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4871-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4871-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

3703-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

5686-7940--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

670-1619-3991-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6135.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Aarakocra Sneak from exile to the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

3532-5078-5901-7719.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
3532-5078-5901-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1494-5436-6822-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4186-6823-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-6823-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3277-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and exiling Ephemerate.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5686-6351-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

659-4381-4613-4742.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-4742.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1020-2866-4668-6518.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1020-2866-4668-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2281-5686-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3941-4331-4993-5645.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

647-2366-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
647-2366-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

933-3908-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
933-3908-7009.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

413-3234-3293-5412.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
413-3234-3293-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When World Shaper enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat
413-3234-3293-5412.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2178-3817-5231-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-5231-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Repeat.

440-1339-4476-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-4476-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2265-3574-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
2060-2265-3574-4222.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-2265-3574-4222.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

3662-3942-4377.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {3}{R}{R}{R} each extra turn
3662-3942-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Walk the Aeons from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chemister from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2097-5437-5742-5743.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

549-5231-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
549-5231-5433.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Repeat.

3565-4424-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
3565-4424-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

939-1308-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Soul Foundry and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1537-2397-3337.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1537-2397-3337.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping Reflection of Kiki-Jiki and the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.

1651-2751-4076-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three members in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
1651-2751-4076-4659.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Burakos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Burakos' ability, causing the defending opponent to lose at least three life, and creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Burakos' ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2815-4891-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {R}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, causing you to put Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling Atsushi from the top of your library and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Activate the three remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from exile by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

232-586-3168-4359-5256.manaNeeded: {B}{R} PLUS ENOUGH MANA TO PAY FOR COMMANDER TAX, IF APPLICABLE
232-586-3168-4359-5256.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix, causing target player to mill two cards.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, causing target player to mill two cards.
Cast Garna by paying {1}{B}{R}.
Garna enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
In response, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Garna, causing target player to mill three cards.
Resolve Garna's ability, returning Garna, Priest of Gix, Priest of Urabrask, and any other creature cards that were put into your graveyard from anywhere this turn from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
